questions.question: What did David do when he had the chance to kill Saul in the cave?
options: Seized hold of him and held him fast as a captive
Cut off a corner of his robe but spared him
Struck him down with his own spear
Slipped away quietly without a word
questions.answer: Cut off a corner of his robe but spared him

questions.question: Why did David refuse to kill Saul?
options: He was badly outnumbered by Saul's men
He was afraid of Saul's revenge
He pitied Saul in his weakness

questions.question: Saul wept and acknowledged that David was more righteous than he.
